statement: ∀ n d l h : ℕ, 1 < n → 0 < d → Squarefree d → d.Coprime n → l ≤ h → h < n → let r : ℝ := (2 : ℝ)^d.primeFactors.card; let A := ((Finset.Icc l h).filter (fun u => u.Coprime n ∧ d ∣ u*(n-u))).card; |(A:ℝ) - ((h-l+1 : ℕ):ℝ)*(n.totient:ℝ)*r/((d:ℝ)*n)| ≤ r*(n.divisors.card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Farey 分母对与逆元筛 · HD-8004 · 在全分子窗给出二元筛的统一 CRT 余项
plain_statement.en: New route · Farey denominator pairs and inverse sieve · HD-8004 · Bound the two-residue sieve remainder with all numerator labels included

brief.zh: 先数允许根，再逐根应用带互素掩码的进程界。令 d 平方自由且与 n 互素。TH-0030、TH-0031 给出每个素因子的 0 与 n 两个根，两个根用同一实例的区间。
brief.en: Count the roots, then apply the masked progression estimate to each root. For squarefree d coprime to n, TH-0030 and TH-0031 identify the two roots 0 and n at each prime factor.
